name: Midpoint Marching Cubes
definition: A surface extraction method using a standard MC look-up table but replacing linear edge interpolation with midpoint selection to determine intersection positions. It reduces the 256 possible cube configurations to 15 basic patterns using reflective and rotational symmetries.
summary: Midpoint Marching Cubes is a surface extraction method that fixes intersection points to edge midpoints, reducing configurations to 15 patterns for computational simplicity at the cost of accuracy.
